days.heading: Arrive Malta and settle in Valletta or Sliema
days.note: Skip the rental car: left-side driving and tight parking make a short Malta stay easier with ferries, taxis, and tours.

spots.cost: St John’s Co-Cathedral: open Mon–Sat 9:00–16:45, last admission 16:00; adults usually ~€15, children/student concessions. Grand Master’s Palace: €12 adult / €10 youth / €8 child 6–11; Throne Room closed until further notice.
spots.climate: Air ~80–84°F / 69–71°F. Malta/Comino sea should be around 73–74°F on Jun 20–22, with sheltered lagoons often feeling warmer.
spots.saveHtml: Save Use Valletta ferries/ride-hail instead of a Malta rental car; left-side driving and parking do not help a 3-night stay.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge A harbor cruise or private dgħajsa boat gives the Grand Harbour view kids remember.
spots.restoHtml:
• I Pupi Pizzeria Valletta — excellent-value pizza, 4.9★, ~$12–20 pp
  • Casa Sotto — Roman pizza in Valletta, top family pizza pick
  • Sally Port Pizzeria — pizza/pasta in Valletta, 4.8★; familiar dinner fallback
spots.altboxHtml:
• Mdina ↗ — quieter medieval “Silent City” if Valletta feels too hot or crowded.
  • Ghajn Tuffieha ↗ — proper sandy beach day without Comino boat logistics.
  • Ramla Bay ↗ — red-sand beach version of a Gozo day if a full island loop is too much.

spots.cost: The 2026 visitor system requires a free pre-booked Blue Lagoon pass to step on land, with morning/afternoon/evening slots; commercial boat trips commonly ~€30–45 adult / child discounts.
spots.climate: Air ~80–84°F / 69–71°F. Comino water should be around 73–74°F on Jun 21, excellent compared with Portugal and usually calmer/warmer-feeling inside the lagoon.
spots.saveHtml: Save Book the free slot yourself before buying a tour; choose the morning slot for clearer water and fewer boats.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private or semi-private Comino/Gozo boat, ~€250–450 family, avoids packed party boats.
spots.restoHtml:
• I Pupi Pizzeria Valletta — excellent-value pizza, 4.9★, ~$12–20 pp
  • Casa Sotto — Roman pizza in Valletta, top family pizza pick
  • Sally Port Pizzeria — pizza/pasta in Valletta, 4.8★; familiar dinner fallback

spots.cost: Gozo Channel return foot passenger €4.65 adult; children 3–12 €1.15; pay on return from Gozo. Fast ferry from Valletta is more, about €8.50 one way.
spots.climate: Air ~80–84°F / 69–71°F. Xlendi/Ramla water should be around 73–75°F on Jun 22.
spots.saveHtml: Save Go as foot passengers and use a Gozo taxi/Bolt for key stops; taking a Malta rental car over adds cost and parking friction.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private Gozo driver for 5–6 hrs, ~€180–280, lets you hit Victoria, Ramla, salt pans and Xlendi without bus waits.
spots.restoHtml:
• Country Terrace — views near Mgarr; pasta, pizza-ish kids choices, ~$18–30 pp
  • Maldonado Bistro — Victoria bistro with pasta/burgers, ~$15–25 pp
  • Front Bar Xlendi — casual seafront, burgers/fries/sandwiches
spots.altboxHtml:
• Ramla Bay ↗ — make it a red-sand beach day instead of a full island loop.
  • Three Cities waterfront ↗ — harbor views and old streets with a calmer feel than Valletta.
  • Popeye Village viewpoint ↗ — kitschy but kid-friendly photo stop near a scenic cove.
